Name: β_vh
Description: Mosquito to human transmission rate.

Name: β_hv
Description: Human to mosquito transmission rate.

Name: β_wm
Description: Women to men sexual transmission rate.

Name: β_mw
Description: Men to women sexual transmission rate.

Name: ϕ
Description: Proportion of human infections that become symptomatic.

Name: λ_h
Description: Rate of progression from exposed to infectious in humans (inverse of intrinsic latent period of 6.8 days).

Name: λ_v
Description: Rate of progression from exposed to infectious in mosquitoes (inverse of extrinsic latent period of 10 days).

Name: γ_1
Description: Rate of viral clearance from blood in humans (inverse of mean time of 10-20 days).

Name: γ_2
Description: Rate of viral clearance from semen in men (inverse of mean time of 10-30 days).

Name: γ_3
Description: Rate of viral clearance from vaginal fluids in women (inverse of mean time of 1-20 days).

Name: ν
Description: Mosquito birth and death rate (inverse of mosquito lifespan of 14 days).

Name: ρ
Description: Proportion of risky sexual interactions in the population (denoted as 'r' in equations).

Name: N_h
Description: Human population at risk.

Name: N_v
Description: Total mosquito population size, used to determine the constant birth rate of mosquitoes.
